name: Saakshi Medtech & Panels Ltd.
summary: Saakshi Medtech & Panels Ltd. is an India-based diversified engineering and manufacturing company that provides engineered solutions for various industries. The company specializes in producing electrical control panels and cabinets, medical X-ray systems, fabrication, and wire harnesses. Its product offerings include medical diagnostic analog and digital X-ray machines, imaging system enclosures, and specialized medical furniture. Saakshi Medtech & Panels Ltd. serves a range of sectors including healthcare, renewable energy (solar and wind), electric vehicles (EV charging stations), locomotives, oil and gas, aviation, and the compressor industry. The company operates as an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) partner, delivering mission-critical components and solutions.
